title: Apply the product changes in one commit

ticket.subject: Supplier changes for dim_product
body: The supplier sent `data/product_changes.csv`: `op` is I (new product), U (update the name, category and
Please apply it to the DuckLake table `dim_product` **as one commit**: readers must see all of the changes
or none of them, so the lake should gain exactly one snapshot. Don't recreate the table.
Work in `merge.sql`. Tried something that went wrong? Start over gives you a clean lake.

acceptance.text: dim_product has every insert, update and delete applied, once

checks.query: SELECT product_id, name, category, price FROM dim_product
checks.expected_query: SELECT product_id, name, category, price FROM dim_product AT (VERSION => 1) WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM read_csv('data/product_changes.csv')) UNION ALL SELECT product_id, name, category, price FROM read_csv('data/product_changes.csv') WHERE op IN ('I', 'U')
checks.fail: The table does not match the change file applied once.

acceptance.text: All of it is one new snapshot on the same table

hints: Outside a transaction each statement commits on its own, and each commit is a snapshot.

`MERGE INTO dim_product t USING (SELECT * FROM read_csv('data/product_changes.csv') WHERE op <> 'D') c ON t.product_id = c.product_id` updates the matched rows and inserts the others in one statement. DuckLake's MERGE takes one UPDATE or DELETE action, so delete the D rows with their own DELETE.
Wrap the DELETE and the MERGE in `BEGIN; … COMMIT;`: one transaction, one snapshot.
